platforms.name: CJSW 90.9 FM Official Jotform EP and Album Upload Route
platforms.country: Canada / Calgary campus and community freeform radio with international digital intake
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or payment requirement is stated on CJSW's official submission page or 2026 Jotform.
platforms.manualReviewReason: CJSW uses an official external Jotform and accepts only digital EPs or albums released within the last three months, with at least three unique tracks; singles are rejected. The full release must be uploaded as MP3 files in a .zip, and the form also requests release metadata, genre, location, bio, RIYL information, artwork, optional one-sheet and explicit permission to share the release with programmers and retain it in the digital library. The form contains an anti-spam field that must remain empty. A human must review the permission, asset rights, release date and all live form controls before upload.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from CJSW's official submission page, live 2026 Jotform and active station homepage. The form identifies electronic among its genre options and the station shows current 2026 programming and Sled Island interviews. The protected Music & Performance Director contact shown on the official page was not decoded or used as a substitute route. No form was submitted, no file uploaded and no permission granted.

platforms.name: CKUT 90.3 FM Official Digital MP3 and Physical Music Submission Route
platforms.country: Canada / Montreal campus-community freeform radio accepting releases from artists worldwide
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or payment requirement is stated in CKUT's official music-submission guidance.
platforms.manualReviewReason: CKUT publicly authorizes 320-kbps MP3 digital submissions to music@ckut.ca and also accepts CDs, cassettes, 12-inch and 7-inch vinyl by mail or drop-off. Singles are rejected; except for 7-inch vinyl, a release must contain at least three distinct tracks and remixes do not count. Physical releases may receive more attention, but review is not guaranteed. A human must confirm that the selected release satisfies the multi-track rule, choose digital or physical delivery, prepare compliant metadata and assets and address any physical package exactly.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from CKUT's official submission and station pages. The official site says DJs select recordings sent by artists and record companies around the world and lists electronic, house, techno, reggae, global, hip-hop and related programming. The music@ckut.ca address is purpose-specific and publicly displayed on the official submission page. No email was sent and no physical package or audio was delivered.

platforms.name: PBS 106.7FM Official International Music Submission Form
platforms.country: Australia / Melbourne community radio explicitly accepting local and international acts
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or payment requirement is stated on PBS FM's official music-submission page.
platforms.manualReviewReason: PBS FM prefers its official digital form and explicitly accepts local and international acts. The form requests identity and location details, artist biography, social links, optional gigs, a stream link and a required free high-quality download link in 320-kbps AAC, MP3, WAV or equivalent; Spotify and Deezer links are not accepted. The page contains a blank anti-spam field and a human-verification CAPTCHA. A human must complete the CAPTCHA, inspect conditional country/state behavior, verify link permissions and approve all assets. Physical CDs or vinyl are also accepted with a one-page press release or bio.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from PBS FM's official submission page and active homepage, which lists 2026 broadcasts, features and events including electronica and cross-continental music. The digital form was identified but not submitted, the anti-spam field was not manipulated, the CAPTCHA was not handled and no physical copies were prepared.

platforms.name: RTRFM 92.1 Official Overseas Form and Music Director Email Route
platforms.country: Australia / Perth independent community radio with an Overseas option in its official form
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or payment requirement is stated on RTRFM's official music-submission page.
platforms.manualReviewReason: RTRFM accepts releases through its official form or the protected Music Team email shown on the same page. The form includes an Overseas location option, requests contact and artist details, a biography document, social links, upcoming gigs, a stream link and a free download link, and contains a hidden validation field that must remain unchanged. RTRFM recommends a downloadable WAV or high-quality MP3 link and says files must not be attached to email. A human must inspect the live form, leave the anti-spam field untouched, verify assets and link rights and confirm the protected email if choosing the email route.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from RTRFM's official submission and active homepage pages. Current July 2026 stories, events and electronic, beats, dance and ambient programs confirm activity. Physical albums and EPs are accepted only alongside a free digital email submission; four or five copies are suggested. Protected email links were not decoded, no form was submitted, no email was sent and no physical package was prepared.

platforms.name: fbi.radio Official Digital Music Director Email Route
platforms.country: Australia / Sydney independent radio championing emerging music
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or payment requirement is stated for fbi.radio's official general music-servicing email route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: fbi.radio publicly directs music submissions to music@fbiradio.com and requires a clear subject, short bio, press image or gig details, a stream link and a free high-quality 320-kbps MP3 or WAV download link. Music for general playlisting must be serviced digitally before midnight Tuesday for Wednesday auditioning; CDs are no longer accepted. A human must prepare the pitch, confirm download permissions and expiry, select general or show-specific servicing and ensure all rights and metadata are correct before sending.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-11 from fbi.radio's official music-submissions, contact and active homepage pages. The station publishes current July 2026 episodes and music features, including electronic and bass-oriented programming. The music@fbiradio.com business address is purpose-specific and publicly displayed. No email was sent, no download link or press asset was delivered and no paid promotional campaign was initiated.
